In the meantime, the order dated 04.03.2017 passed by the learned ACJM VIII, Siwan in Complaint Case No 2410 of 2016, whereby cognizance of offence punishable under Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.46234 of 2023(2) dt.19-10-2023 Sections 498A and 384 of IPC has been taken,

shall remain stayed, as it is submitted that petitioner is the husband of Opposite Party No 2 and she was living with the petitioner for the last 14 years but still she could not conceive despite all medical care and it was at the instance of Opposite Party No 2 that the petitioner performed his second marriage out of which three children were born.

It is also submitted that the petitioner is paying Madan Mohan Das vs The State Of Bihar on 19 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/47684525/
1 maintenance of Rs 15,000/- to Opposite Party No 2.
